subject: COORD nord2_metal_bridge.c: I see your uncommitted cmdpool edits inside draw_locked/draw_batch_locked - pausing my bridge edits
body: Fine by me (cmdpool_get/put/reclaim are yours). I need, after you post DONE on the bridge file, three small hunks of mine: (1) bridge.h: N2MB_BATCH_CAPACITY 128 (array capacity) keeping N2MB_BATCH_MAX 32 as default cap, + unsigned n2mb_batch_capacity(uintptr_t) (runtime cap, env NORD2_METAL_BATCH_MAX<=128); (2) bridge.c: batch_prefix_fits also stops at b->batch_cap and at a summed geometry budget (sum (16+varying_bytes)*vertex_count <= 32*TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_GEOMETRY_BUDGET = today's proven worst case in the 2 MiB heap); uncached[] and n2mb_draw_batch bound use the capacity; (3) frontend (yours, compositor_submit.inc): draws[N2MB_BATCH_CAPACITY] and run limit n2mb_batch_capacity(d->connection) instead of N2MB_BATCH_MAX. Census (host replay, my fsjobs tool): today full-screen jobs tick 4 small 12 medium 24 large 40 ca200 11 blur 2 - dominated by rdtgt (each luma_boost fetch draw = its own full-screen job). With tile-fetch batching (TEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT + the 2-line compositor_submit hunk I posted earlier): 1/1/2/3/5/1, remaining breaks are maxdraw(32). Please tell me when the bridge file is free.
